scorecard.rationale: The Parkinson figure shows a small inverse tile for unspecified egg frequency and falls without a precise estimate or poaching identity. The older-adult study reports 2.03 versus 2.21 weekly portions in fall-with-fracture cases and controls with unadjusted p=.07, and has no adjusted fall-frequency or preparation-specific estimate. Nutri-Park used protein timing. The new European nutrition review includes raw egg vitamin D composition and population food-source contributions with no egg-specific fall outcome. These results leave poached eggs and Parkinson fall frequency open.
